_comment: Tracks terms suggested via the site's 'Suggest a term' form. A GitHub Action (term-suggestion-intake.yml) updates this automatically when a labeled issue comes in. When a term is independently suggested 'threshold' times, the Action drafts a pending entry at the bottom of GLOSSARY.md and opens a PR for a maintainer to review - nothing here is ever merged into the real glossary automatically.

candidates.meaning: A command that checks your project's dependencies for known security problems and tells you how many it found.
candidates.picture: A quick health inspection of every ingredient in your pantry, flagging any that have been recalled.
candidates.note: It's just running a routine check, not fixing or changing anything in your code yet.
